result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the green promotional banner has noticeable spacing and alignment problems: the heading sits too close to the top edge, and the button is not aligned with the text.

issues.description: The text "3 free deliveries for you" and its subheading are positioned too close to the top-left edge of the green promo banner, making the heading appear nearly clipped and poorly aligned within the banner.
issues.suggestion: Increase the top padding of the banner and align the heading and description consistently with the left edge of the "Order now" button.

issues.description: The "Order now" button is very close to the left edge of the promo banner, which makes it look partially misaligned compared with the text above it.
issues.suggestion: Use the same horizontal inset for the button and the promotional text so the banner content looks balanced.
